## Destination Facts
- **Kawah Ijen**: 2386 m; Banyuwangi; Crater rim elevation 2386 m; Trail distance (one-way) 3 km; Ascent time 90 min; Difficulty level Strenuous — steep rocky night hike from Paltuding trailhead; Crater lake acidity ≈ pH 0 (highest-volume acidic crater lake on Earth); Blue fire Pre-dawn sulfuric-gas phenomenon; weather- and gas-dependent, not guaranteed; Health certificate Mandatory for every guest before crater entry (BBKSDA SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024); Best time to visit Dry season (April–October); midnight departure for the blue-fire window.
- **Madakaripura Waterfall**: 620 m; Probolinggo.
- **Mount Bromo**: 2329 m; Probolinggo; Summit elevation 2329 m; Sunrise viewpoint elevation 2770 m; Difficulty level Easy to moderate — short crater-rim walk, 4WD jeep access to the caldera; 4WD jeep Mandatory for Penanjakan viewpoint and Sea of Sand access (included in JVTO packages); Health certificate Not required (no sulfuric-gas exposure at tourist viewing points); Best time to visit Dry season (April–October); pre-dawn 03:00–05:00 for sunrise; Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park entrance (foreign visitor, per person) IDR 160000.
- **Papuma Beach**: 5 m; Jember.
- **Tumpak Sewu Waterfall**: 400 m; Lumajang.

- [Why Travel with Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO)](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/why-jvto): JVTO is a registered Indonesian tour operator for private Bromo, Ijen, Tumpak Sewu and Papuma routes from Surabaya or Bali. The model is Tourist Police-led, NIB 1102230032918, 100% private, all-inclusive, and backed by published policies, crew profiles, reviews and verification pages.
- [Verify JVTO: A Proof Library You Can Check](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/verify-jvto): The evidence locker for PT Java Volcano Rendezvous — legal, police-authority, press, and history documents, each checkable against an independent...
- [Ijen Health Certificate — Real Checks, Digital Proof](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/ijen-health-screening): Before Kawah Ijen crater entry, every guest needs a doctor-issued health certificate under BBKSDA SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024. JVTO coordinates a real hotel-based screening with vitals checks and a BSrE-signed digital certificate. If a guest is not cleared, only that guest's climb is cancelled and safe-zone alternatives apply.
- [Ijen Rijik: The Monthly Closure Day at Kawah Ijen](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/rijik-monthly-closure): Kawah Ijen closes to all visitors on the first Friday of every month for Rijik, a scheduled conservation cleanup running since March 2019. Park staff and volunteers typically remove an estimated 100-150 kg of waste. JVTO checks this calendar before confirming Ijen-inclusive itineraries and schedules around it.
- [Booking Information – How JVTO Private Tours Work](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/booking-information): JVTO bookings happen only on javavolcano-touroperator.com, in five steps: choose route and dates, review price and add-ons, accept terms and pay a 20% deposit (up to 100% if Day 1 is within 14 days), then receive your Official E-Voucher PDF. Full legal terms: /policy/booking-payment-cancellation.
- [Traffic Police Escort for Tourist Groups in East Java](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/police-escort-for-groups): For tourist groups, usually around 18 guests or more, JVTO can request an official traffic police escort through the relevant Ditlantas unit. It is a formal approval process, not a guaranteed add-on. When approved, the escort supports road coordination on selected East Java segments.
- [JVTO Policy Hub](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/policy): JVTO policy pages define the booking, payment, cancellation, inclusions, exclusions and privacy rules that apply before a private tour is confirmed. The binding order starts with the official e-voucher or invoice PDF, then the published policy pages, then supporting travel-guide guidance for operational details.
